method: Batch 45 (horses): the batch 44 harness with horses of fixed type, variant, tame flag, age and attribute bases (Q, q, D, F, Y, R), horses built by onSpawnWithEgg (V; record.init holds the spawn draws), feeding through EntityPlayer.interactWith and breeding through EntityAIMate (row element 6 of a horse is [love, growingAge, type, variant, tame, temper, max health, speed, jump, health] with the attribute bases as doubles; row element 5 lists the horses spawned that tick in the same form). Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
